shortDescription: Module for get information about credentials in senhasegura PAM

options.name: client_id
options.description: A2A OAuth2 client_id, SENHASEGURA_CLIENT_ID environment variable may also be used

options.name: client_secret
options.description: A2A OAuth2 client_secret, SENHASEGURA_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable may also be used

options.name: id_credential
options.description: The credential ID to get information

options.name: identifier
options.description: The credential identifier to get information

options.name: system_url
options.description: senhasegura's environment URL used for authentication, SENHASEGURA_URL environment variable may also be used

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate or not the HTTPS certificate
